lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately five horizontal rows posterior to the branchial region, forming a predictable lattice.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal spot rows to create a grid-like arrangement of high-intensity nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant horizontal ridge is visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp transition from high-intensity pixels dorsally to shadow-filled pixels ventrally.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct irregular notch is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the left pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: A prominent high-contrast white remora is attached to the ventral base of the pectoral fin, with multiple additional darker remoras visible in the ventral water column.
